nodes.label: Post-Commit Auto-Rebuild Hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per git commit, re-runs AST extraction on files changed via git diff HEAD~1 and rebuilds graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md; doc/image changes are ignored and need a manual --update.

nodes.label: Native CLAUDE.md Integration
nodes.rationale: graphify claude install writes a ## graphify section into the project's CLAUDE.md so future sessions check/rebuild the graph automatically without a manual /graphify invocation.
